The zeros sit under G0 finite_buffers_ports_tags_credits / write_visibility_lifetimes, G2 backpressure_reset_drain_CDC, G4 measured_stalls_service_collectives (tools/current_final_number_readiness.py:20-33). global_findings.sensitivity_qwen_hbm: Stream-bound. With a delta of +2/+5/+12/+26/+50 cycles on every one of 181 boundaries, token cycles go from 1,247,686 to 1,247,688/691/698/712/736 (<=0.004%). Qwen HBM per-user rate is insensitive to every latency-type zero in the list. Only added HBM bytes would move it: KV-fence RMW (18,432 x 32 B) plus metadata reads (74,304 x 32 B) total about 3.0 MB against roughly 8.2 GB per token (about 0.04%).
global_findings.sensitivity_ds_hbm: Chain-bound and serial (T = sum of parts). nb = 329 boundaries at 1.0339 GHz, so each cycle per boundary costs 0.318 us, or 0.089% of rate. +2 -> -0.18%, +5 -> -0.44%, +8 -> -0.71%, +12 -> -1.06%, +26 -> -2.27%. The AGENTS 1% gate is crossed at about 11.3 cycles per boundary. DS HBM is the only combination where these terms can be claim-determining.
global_findings.ROM_designs: Qwen ROM and DS ROM headlines do not read any of these records. The r14 provider (item 2) and the HDC PC service (item 1) feed only the non-adopted Qwen ROM KV calendars (qwen_rom_kv_credit17 model-r3 adoption False; beat_retirement model-r3 REJECT).

That is 128 x 3,891.6 um2 x 32 x 1.31 = about 20.9 mm2 per die omitted from used_mm2 (Qwen 152.0, V4.1 187.9 of 688.4). It does not flip fits=true, but it is an area under-statement.

The prior audit's 'C0/V1 model consumes two independently timed mirror ACKs' defect is half-wrong: SerializedOwner.ack (tools/h4_v1_physical_join.py:161-170) requires the same stall count for both mirrors and adds 2+stalls ONCE, so time is a combined ACK. The two-call protocol shape still differs from RTL's single ack_valid (rtl/gpu/ot_gpu_rf_service.sv:46).
